name: scene-2
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Make ONE separate 1024x1536 portrait preschool coloring page from this scene. Keep the Elder hedgehog with round glasses leaning beside little PinPin over an open book, and the Elder's paw pointing at ONE enormous simple heart-shaped leaf drawing. PinPin looks closely at the leaf. Emphasize the teaching interaction and the broad leaf: overhead-oblique view of the huge open book filling the lower half of page, both friendly heads and pointing paws above it. One plain feather quill and ink pot at far side; no lamp needed, no shelf clutter, writing, map or background details. Entire sheet MUST be opaque WHITE (#FFFFFF), never transparent. BLACK thick smooth outlines only, large enclosed WHITE areas for a FOUR-YEAR-OLD with crayons. Leaf has just one center vein and four branch veins, no labels; quills are simple zigzag silhouette and a few large inner shapes. Keep correct two front paws per character, glasses clear, adult larger than child. No thin fur strokes, grey, shading, hatching, texture, gradients, shadows, color, letters, words, numbers, borders or panels. Complete clean scene within generous print margins.

review.notes: Distinct overhead close leaf lesson; huge fillable leaf, two paws per hedgehog and clear glasses, no lettering.
